usage: A small fastening part on jewellery, bags, belts, or clothing. In everyday speech, 扣 is usually the little piece that opens and closes something securely.
Very common with jewellery items like 頸鏈、手鏈、腳鏈. It is the hardware part, not the decoration itself.
Can sound neutral and practical, so it works well in shop talk, repair talk, and daily conversation.
Learners should remember that this word refers to the clasp mechanism, not the whole accessory.
